Land of Bad (2024) is an intense action thriller directed by William Eubank that presents a high-stakes, technology-driven look at modern military operations. The film introduces Captain Eddie "Reaper" Grimm (Russell Crowe), a veteran U.S. Air Force drone pilot operating out of Las Vegas, and Sergeant JJ "Kinetic" Kinney (Liam Hemsworth), a young, inexperienced Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC) assigned to a Delta Force rescue mission in the dense jungles of the southern Philippines. What begins as a routine extraction quickly spirals out of control when the ground team is ambushed, leaving Kinney isolated behind enemy lines with only Reaper’s aerial perspective and drone support to guide him toward survival.

​The main plot unfolds over a relentlessly paced multi-day struggle as Kinney attempts to evade heavily armed insurgents and make his way to safety. Deprived of heavy infantry backup, Kinney's life hinges entirely on his ability to communicate with Reaper, thousands of miles away, who monitors the battlefield through thermal imagery and precision missile strikes. As communication links fail, military bureaucracy threatens to stall rescue efforts, and ground casualties mount, Kinney must adapt to brutal combat conditions while Reaper fights his own battles against institutional indifference back at base to keep his eyes on the ground and his pilot connection alive.

​At its core, Land of Bad explores deep themes of brotherhood, accountability, moral duty, and the human cost of modern warfare. The film contrasts the physical reality of soldiers facing immediate death on the ground with the psychological burden borne by remote drone operators who watch the violence unfold on screens. It highlights how technology can simultaneously bridge massive physical distances and create a sense of helplessness when systems fail, emphasizing that real military success relies not on weaponry or automated intelligence, but on the unyielding commitment between individual human beings to leave no one behind.

source_details.synopsis: Land of Bad is a 2024 American action thriller film directed by William Eubank, who co-wrote the script with David Frigerio. The film stars Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Ricky Whittle, and Milo Ventimiglia, and follows a US Army Delta Force team on a rescue operation that comes under attack from terrorists. Land of Bad was released theatrically on February 16, 2024. It grossed $7 million worldwide.
